title: Add an "archived" boolean status, and the ability to archive stories from the done column (add an Archive button to the top of any column that maps to a Closed superstate) which should archive all stories currently in that column/state, which hides them from the primary UI. This way, columns like Done become a way to see recently-closed stories. Also add an Archive button (with confirmation popup) to the detail page of each individual story.

awaiting: Deferred during data-layer rearchitecture: touches the store schema mid-rebuild; must not leak into the W1 schema; re-spec after W1/W5
